properties.areaDesc: Coastal Del Norte; Northern Coastal Humboldt; Southwestern Humboldt; Coastal Mendocino
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 11 at 10:54PM PDT until October 12 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...A very long period westerly swell will increase the
threat of sneaker waves.

* WHERE...Coastal Del Norte, Northern Coastal Humboldt,
Southwestern Humboldt and Coastal Mendocino Counties.

* WHEN...Through Monday afternoon. The risk will increase as winds
weaken.

* IMPACTS...Large, unexpected waves can sweep across the beach
without warning, sweeping people into the sea from rocks,
jetties, and beaches. These sneaker waves can also move large
objects such as logs, crushing anyone caught underneath.
properties.instruction:
Don't be fooled by an ocean that looks calm.  There can be
30 minutes of small waves before a sneaker wave strikes.  Avoid
rocks and jetties. Avoid steep beaches.  Stay much farther back
from the water and never turn your back on the ocean.

properties.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 11 at 10:39PM PDT until October 12 at 8:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
properties.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 28 to 32 expected.

* WHERE...Upper Hood River Valley County.

* WHEN...Until 8 AM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Expect the coldest temperatures near Parkdale.
properties.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender outdoor plants from the cold.
Consider temporarily moving outdoor potted plants indoors if they are
sensitive to cold temperatures.

Consider temporarily covering sensitive plants with a lightweight
cotton fabric (i.e., bedsheets, thin blankets), as this will help
retain heat and provide frost protection for your plants.

dangers of flooding.

properties.description:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt, becoming
northwest with seas 4 to 7 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Fenwick Island DE to Chincoteague
VA out 20 NM and Coastal waters from Chincoteague to Parramore
Island VA out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
properties.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

NWSheadline: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 6 PM EDT THIS EVENING
